rules.episode: For each symbol/window/N, a first completed close breaking prior N highs by one tick starts an episode and freezes that boundary. No further episode until a later completed close<=that frozen boundary; rearming close cannot also start a new episode. Each research window starts with an empty armed episode state; warmup supplies ATR and prior-N channel only. Count all raw qualifying closes separately. Ignore real position and risk gates.
rules.confirmation: close-tick accepts first episode close; close-buffer accepts only when that same first close exceeds frozen U by max(one tick,0.25*signal ATR), no later wait; two-close accepts only if the immediately following completed close still exceeds the first frozen U by one tick. It uses second-close ATR and next minute fill. All variants share baseEpisodeId; report accepted coverage plus skipped base winners/stop-outs.
rules.referenceFill: Use native long entry convention: next minute open with base slippage and adverse price-grid rounding. Stop uses the same 2 ATR initial distance and adverse grid rounding; R is actual rounded entry minus rounded initial stop. This is a signal diagnostic with no capital allocation, positions, funding or realized cost-adjusted strategy equity.
rules.labels: Observe complete 24-bar (12-hour) forward minute windows from each definition entry. For targets +1R and +2R against -1R, test minute open before high/low; same-minute high/low double touch is ambiguous, expose optimistic/pessimistic bounds. Neither touch within full horizon is horizon-censored, not a loss. Insufficient future minutes are tail-excluded, not horizon-censored. False breakout: one of the first four subsequent completed 30-minute closes<=frozen episode U. It is a price-geometry label, not a trade loss. Fixed-horizon MFE/MAE includes only post-reference-entry minutes, regardless of first touch or native trade exit.
rules.sampling: Primary table includes all base episodes and reports overlap/dependence. Also choose a causal shared nonoverlap subset by chronological first episode, locking until the delayed-confirmation possible entry plus full 24-bar horizon; lock does not end early on target/stop. Apply that same base subset to all definitions and report coverage and outcome denominators. Each window resets; never choose subsets based on outcomes.
rules.uncertainty: Use seven-calendar-day circular-block resampling on event-origin daily counts (all coins in a day travel together), 2000 draws with seed20261003. Rates keep their matching numerator/denominator per replicate; no independent-binomial significance. Aggregate and symbol summaries retained. No multiple-testing correction; diagnostic intervals are descriptive.
rules.alignment: Independently derive 30-minute candles, Wilder ATR and prior-N boundary from hash-verified traded-price minute archives with native candidate warmup. Match native tick entrySignal snapshots, regardless of episode sampling, before publishing. Buffer and two-close are not native implemented account policies.

limitations: All windows were previously observed; no untouched out-of-sample claim.
Price-path event labels ignore account positions, risk gates, capital, fees and funding; they are not strategy returns.
Within-horizon success bounds count ambiguity separately; horizon-censored outcomes remain in the complete-horizon denominator and are not called losses.
Calendar block intervals are descriptive, preserve same-day cross-coin grouping, and do not correct multiple testing.
No Wilson/binomial independence inference. Shared nonoverlap subset is selected only from episode times, not future outcomes.
Only close-tick shares native trigger semantics; buffer/two-close are event-study hypotheses, not native execution rules.
